Within South Africa, the fleet composition of major competitors highlights a readiness to handle complex and demanding projects, reflecting the diverse lifting needs of the region. Historical strategies, such as the strategic rollout of their "Big Five" large mobile cranes in 2018, emphasize their long-standing commitment to heavy-lift capabilities and project readiness, although the specific configurations and current operational status of these initiatives may have evolved over time . Other prominent entities in the market, such as Concord Cranes and Marlboro Crane Hire, have also demonstrated a strong commitment to bolstering their heavy-lift capacities to maintain a competitive edge [11] . In May 2023, these companies significantly expanded their operational fleets by acquiring two 100-ton Liebherr LTM 1100-5.3 all-terrain cranes . This development reflects a targeted interest in enhancing specialized lifting capabilities within the region to accommodate increasingly complex infrastructure, mining, and industrial demands .
